item.title: Feature: The Best Hidden Gems And Underrated Switch 1 & 2 Games Of 2025
item.description: Celebrating the small(er).2025 has been a bit of a loud, bonkers year for video games. item.title: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties Direct Showcases New Modes Bad Boy Dragon And Hell's Arena
item.description: Update: Check out 6 minutes of gameplay.SEGA and Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio have announced that they will be airing a Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties Direct next week, which launches on Switch 2 on 12th February 2026.The Direct will be a late one for UK and European folks, with the stream kicking off on 23rd December 2025 at 1am GMT / 2am ET — that's 22nd December at 5pm PT / 8pm ET for those in North America. It'll be available on both YouTube and Twitch.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: IO Interactive's '007 First Light' Hit By Two Month Delay
item.description: Never say never again.007 First Light, a brand new James Bond game from the developers of the Hitman series, has been delayed, IO Interactive has announced.
